summary: This document is a comprehensive Two-Wheeler Package Policy issued by The New India Assurance Co. Ltd. It outlines the terms, conditions, and coverage details for motorcycles, scooters, or other two-wheeled vehicles. The policy is divided into two main sections: Section I covers loss or damage to the insured vehicle due to various perils, including fire, theft, natural disasters, and accidents, subject to depreciation rates for parts replaced. Section II covers third-party liability for bodily injury, death, or property damage. The document also defines the Insured’s Declared Value (IDV), depreciation schedules for IDV and parts, exclusions, conditions for repair authorization, and provisions for third-party claims. The policy is legally binding and incorporates the proposal and declaration as part of the contract.
